data.question: Why was FCRM-2026-0151 routed to committee instead of closed by the analyst? (chain: 67 records, head 97359b50)

sentences.text: The first score put the case in Band 2, which was marked for delegated close.
Routing rule R1 says the analyst closes a Band 1 or 2 case under delegated authority.
The system also flagged that the score was 0.3 below the Band 3 edge and required acknowledgement.
Later, Rahul Iyer overrode the CTL-T01 rating from 7.6 to 4.5. The record says a reason was recorded but the summary does not show the reason.
The score was then recomputed as a composite of 10.4 in Band 3, and the record states the route as committee.

quotes: Band change and boundary flag acknowledged by analyst
sentences.text: The analyst acknowledged the band change and the boundary flag.
The case was then released to three committee members for a vote.

data.question: What was overridden on FCRM-2026-0151, and why? (chain: 67 records, head 97359b50)

sentences.text: The record shows one human override: the rating for control CTL-T01 was changed from 7.6 to 4.5 by Rahul Iyer.
The reason is not in the audit records. Record 49 says only that a reason was recorded, and its full payload (which I read) holds no reason text, so I cannot say why the override was made.
The next record states the result after the override: a recomputed composite of 10.4, Band 3, routed to committee.

data.question: How did the committee reach its outcome on FCRM-2026-0151? (chain: 67 records, head 97359b50)

sentences.text: The first score computed was a composite of 9.8 in Band 2, with delegated close.
Rahul Iyer then overrode the CTL-T01 rating from 7.6 to 4.5, with the reason recorded.
The score was then recomputed as a composite of 10.4 in Band 3, and the record states the route as committee.

quotes: Band change and boundary flag acknowledged by analyst
sentences.text: The analyst acknowledged the band change and the boundary flag.
The pack was released to 3 committee members, with votes hidden until all were cast.
Ana Mendes asked a question of the analyst in a thread visible to all members.

quotes: attached as pack addendum · numbers unchanged
sentences.text: Rahul Iyer answered, the answer was attached as a pack addendum, and the numbers were unchanged.
All three votes were cast and each stayed hidden.
The tally, done by code, was approve with conditions 2 and defer 1.
The outcome was set as approved with conditions, and 3 conditions were activated.
